source: Actual Earth Engine Code Editor authenticated console result, 20 October 2026 local date
selection: Each district: maximum native-pixel interior distance among class 3 in all 2000-2021 annual images and 2024. These are source-class-selected probes, not reference truth.
before_after: Raw scene max, daily mosaics, monthly medians, two-day rule: raw and daily maxima equal, monthly and two-day maxima equal in these probes.
scope: Small-area stage diagnostic only. No universal score cap, global bug exclusion or independent accuracy established.
